mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT sum(file.size_bytes) FROM files file WHERE file.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND file.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM session_resources resource WHERE resource.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND resource.file_uuid = file.uuid AND ( resource.file_ownership = 'owned' OR resource.resource_type = 'skill_archive' ) AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL ) ), 0) AS files_bytes, COALESCE(( SELECT sum(file.size_bytes) FROM files file JOIN session_resources resource ON resource.file_uuid = file.uuid AND resource.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND resource.resource_type = 'file' AND resource.file_ownership = 'owned' AND resource.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE file.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND file.deleted_at IS NULL ), 0) AS filestore_bytes
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_storage_usage ( workspace_uuid, files_bytes, filestore_bytes, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.FilesBytes}, #{params.FilestoreBytes}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid) DO UPDATE SET files_bytes = excluded.files_bytes, filestore_bytes = excluded.filestore_bytes, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
INSERT INTO workspace_storage_usage (workspace_uuid) VALUES (#{workspaceUUID}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT files_bytes, filestore_bytes FROM workspace_storage_usage WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_storage_usage SET files_bytes = #{params.FilesBytes}, filestore_bytes = #{params.FilestoreBytes}, updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID}
